sections.title: Treasure Maps
sections.note: 31 maps, listed by the sea they're found in; each marks a Sunken Treasure to raise with the Salvage Arm.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: In a chest in a grassy clearing off the beehive path in the north-west of the island, on your first visit.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southwestern Sea, south-west of Molida Island, near Spirit Island.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: In the Old Wayfarer's second hideaway: mark the four Stone Tablets, dig under the palm tree where the lines cross and open the chest below.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southwestern Sea, north-east of Mercay Island.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Dig the lower-right dark spot in the basement of Astrid's House.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northwestern Sea, south-west of the Isle of Gust.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Cut the lone patch of grass just north-east of the Temple of Fire's entrance and dig there (Kayo's spirit hints at it).

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northwestern Sea, south-east of Bannan Island, reached from the Northeastern Sea.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Mark the four stone tiles, join the eastern pair and the western pair, and dig where the lines meet near a palm tree in the south.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southwestern Sea, north of Molida Island.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Dig directly in front of the Boing Statue in the pond on the island's west side, the whale's eye.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northwestern Sea, west of Bannan Island.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Defeat the ten Miniblins in the pit in the cave in the south of the island; a second chest appears.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northwestern Sea, east of the Isle of Gust.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: In a chest in the south-east corner of the northern desert with the windmills and Sandworms.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southwestern Sea, south-east of Mercay Island.

items.name: Treasure Map #9
items.after: After the Temple of the Ocean King's B6

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Buy it for 50 Rupees from Ojibe on Mercay's dock once you've found the Sun Key's crest and have the Salvage Arm.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southwestern Sea, west of Cannon Island.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Dig just south of the tree by the cave next to Oshus's house (a statue near the Temple of Courage hints at it).

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northwestern Sea, south-east of the Isle of Gust.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: On B6, shoot the Eyeball Switch just west of the entrance; a timed chest appears in the north-east.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northwestern Sea, north of the Isle of Gust.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Talk to Freedle on Mercay's north-east isle.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southeastern Sea, north of Dee Ess Island.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Talk to the girl in red near Molida's dock.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southeastern Sea, east of Harrow Island.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Help the scared young Goron north of the dock: dig up the Updraft beside him and shoot the three Yellow ChuChus on the ledge.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southeastern Sea, north-east of Goron Island.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: In the north-east of 1F, drop a Bomb from the bridge onto the switch in the sand below and run to the chest that appears.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southeastern Sea, south of the Isle of Frost.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: At the North Maze's entrance, steer a Bombchu through the small hole on the left path to the switch; a timed chest appears in the island's north-east.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southwestern Sea, south of Cannon Island.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Cross to the small isle south-west of the Anouki Estates and dig the snow in its centre.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northwestern Sea, north-east of the Isle of Gust.

items.name: Treasure Map #18

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Play the Digging Game (50 Rupees) until this map turns up; where it's buried changes every game.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southeastern Sea, north-west of Goron Island.

items.notes: Zelda Dungeon numbers the Harrow Island maps #14, #15, #24 and #25; Zelda Wiki #18, #19, #24 and #25 (docs/ph.md).

items.name: Treasure Map #19

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Play the Digging Game until this map turns up; it's one of the first two there.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southeastern Sea, west of Goron Island.

items.notes: Zelda Dungeon numbers the Harrow Island maps #14, #15, #24 and #25; Zelda Wiki #18, #19, #24 and #25 (docs/ph.md).

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: From the tablet on the east shore, grapple the barrel across the water onto the tablet to free a Cucco, glide to the islets and dig below the tree.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northwestern Sea, east of Bannan Island.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Dig just left of the sign in front of the Old Wayfarer's Hut (a Gossip Stone at the Anouki Estates hints at it).

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southwestern Sea, north-west of Molida Island.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Slingshot from the two pegs on the north-east isle to the islet with three tablets, then dig between the two chests on the large isle.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southeastern Sea, south of Harrow Island.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: On B4, send a Bombchu through the holes to the switch that lowers the spikes by the north-west stairs. On B5, dig, hit the switch and open the chest in the alcove.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Southeastern Sea, north-west of the Isle of Frost.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Play the Digging Game until this map turns up; it's one of the two added later.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northeastern Sea, south-west of the Isle of Ruins, inside the ring of rocks.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Play the Digging Game until this map turns up; it's one of the two added later.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northeastern Sea, south-east of the Isle of the Dead, inside the ring of rocks.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Board the Traveler's Ship in the Northeastern Sea, defeat the Octoroks and Geozard, and take the Man of Smiles's reward; he gives the map along with the Hero's New Clothes.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northeastern Sea, west of the Isle of Ruins, between two rock barriers.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Clear the Treasure Maze's Normal level (50 Rupees: eight Boing Statues in 100 seconds).

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northeastern Sea, east of Maze Island.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Bomb the wall in McNey's cave, cross the Rupoor maze and open the second of the four chests from the left.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northeastern Sea, north-west of the Isle of Ruins.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: After the secret underground cavern, surface by the King's Eye and open the chest nearby.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northeastern Sea, west of Maze Island.

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Hammer the floor switch in the far south-west corner of B10 for a large chest.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northeastern Sea, south of the Isle of Ruins.

items.name: Treasure Map #31

tiers.name: Map
tiers.howTo: Hit the crystal switch on B12 (reached by the east stairs from B11), then spring over the ledge with the Hammer to the timed chest at the east end.

tiers.name: Salvaged
tiers.howTo: Salvage the X it marks in the Northeastern Sea, south of the Isle of the Dead.

items.notes: Its Sunken Treasure also holds a few Bonus Rupees, as every salvage does.
